default.notes: Free 30-day tourist visa granted on arrival to all nationalities. You need a confirmed booking, funds for your stay, an onward ticket and the Imuga declaration submitted within 96 hours before arrival.

MV.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Maldivian citizens.

IL.notes: Israeli passport holders are barred from entering the Maldives under the entry ban announced in 2024 and signed into law in 2025. The ban applies to travel on an Israeli passport — dual nationals may be able to enter on another passport.
